test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Lose your marbles
solution:
The **correct answer** is 'Option 3' i.e.** 'To become insane'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom at hand is **"Lose your marbles"** which is a way of saying that someone is losing their sanity or becoming crazy.
